item.title: Strait of Hormuz Blockade: The Essential Guide to Trump's Naval Gamble
item.description:
Strait of Hormuz Blockade: The Essential Guide to Trump’s Naval Gamble

About 20% of the world’s oil and gas used to move through a stretch of water barely 21 miles wide at its narrowest point. As of this week, the US Navy is deciding who gets to cross it.

The strait of hormuz us blockade began at roughly 10 a.m. ET on April 13, 2026, after peace talks in Pakistan between Washington and Tehran collapsed the day before. President Donald Trump ordered US Central Command to intercept vessels traveling to or from Iranian ports, turning a seven-week war into a global economic standoff.

item.title: Ali Mohammad Naeini: The New Voice of Iran's Revolutionary Guard Explained
item.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has a new public face — and he’s already making waves. Brigadier General Ali Mohammad Naeini, a veteran of 94 months on the Iran-Iraq War frontlines and a scholar of “soft warfare,” was recently appointed as the IRGC’s official spokesperson. His first major public statements have drawn global attention, particularly his claims about Iran’s performance in what he calls the “12-day war” against Israel.
